_doc: Policy for dynamic mine-network (game/fleet/mine_net.py). Auto-rotates miners across unsaturated belts (>=15% floor), matching fitted tools, prioritizing reserve/needs.tsv shortages, skipping full reserves, and stamping instant cooldowns on floor breach.
_zero_note: 2026-11-25 (Trinity, Suggi directive preserving Zero anti-copper fix): kept market_min_bid=10 against bloated copper/nitrogen, restored allow_lawless_for_deficit=true (calm 0-pirate/6h lawless deficit belts like iron/silicon/uranium), lawless_min_tier=1 for T1+ upgraded miners, needs_max_priority=3 (matches priority_resources silicon_ore), high_value_market_min_bid=25 (fury/phase crystals, plasma/chlorine gas), max_station_jumps=6, xp_fallback_max_jumps=8 (penalizing bloated junk) to eliminate 71% no-belt stalls.
